title: Rating Rule — Policy-Change Courtesy by Length of Policyholding (Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing)
content:
## Rule

On a policy-number amendment of a Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing certificate, the policy-change courtesy percentage follows the whole months from the inception date of the named insured's Cardinal Personal Auto Policy in force today to today:

| Whole months from the inception date of the policy in force today | Policy-change courtesy percentage |
|---|---|
| 84 or more | 20 percent |
| At least 36 but fewer than 84 | 10 percent |
| Fewer than 36 | None |

**Which policy.** The named insured's policy whose status is in force today, with the inception date that policy's record shows.

## Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical dates, today 1 September 2026)

| Inception date of the policy in force | Whole months | Courtesy |
|---|---|---|
| 2 September 2019 | 83 | 10 percent |
| 1 September 2019 | 84 | 20 percent |
| 2 September 2023 | 35 | None |
| 1 September 2023 | 36 | 10 percent |
